discovery.summary: Generate multi-panel comic strips (xkcd / manga / ligne-claire / pop-art / graphic-novel / snoopy) via Gemini, optionally refined with Qwen-Edit and stitched horizontally / vertically / on a grid.

hints.when: picking or mapping a style (xkcd, manga, ligne-claire, pop-art, graphic-novel, snoopy, custom inline)
writing panel prompts (specifics, speech bubbles, expressions, scene)
choosing CLI flags, layout, API mode (rt vs batch), or estimating timing
running the interactive picker (story / style / panels / layout / API mode) including the Telegram inline keyboard pattern
needing a worked example (3-panel xkcd, manga with refinement)
listing the bundled style TOMLs available to the binary

tools.name: mofa_comic
tools.spawn_only_message: SUCCESS: Comic generation is now running in background. The comic image will be automatically delivered when ready. No further action needed for this request.
tools.description: Generate multi-panel comic strips with AI-generated art. Runs in background — do NOT wait for it.

refine_prompt.description: Optional Qwen-Edit instruction to refine this panel after generation (e.g. 'make the sky more dramatic')

out.description: Output PNG file path. Use a relative path (e.g. output.png) — never use /tmp.

api.description: API mode: rt (realtime, fast) or batch (50% cheaper, async)
